description: This file declares the QuicStreamFactoryPeer class with static methods for testing and manipulating QUIC stream factory instances, including session management, configuration, and internal state access.

classes.name: QuicStreamFactoryPeer
classes.description: A testing utility class providing static methods to access and modify internal states and configurations of QuicStreamFactory instances for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetConfig
methods.description: Returns the QuicConfig associated with a given QuicStreamFactory.

methods.name: GetCryptoConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the QuicCryptoClientConfigHandle for a given factory and network anonymization key.

methods.name: HasActiveSession
methods.description: Checks if there is an active session for a specific server ID and network key.

methods.name: HasActiveJob
methods.description: Checks if there is an active job for a specific server ID.

methods.name: GetPendingSession
methods.description: Returns the pending QuicChromiumClientSession for a given server ID and destination.

methods.name: GetActiveSession
methods.description: Returns the active QuicChromiumClientSession for a given server ID and network key.

methods.name: HasLiveSession
methods.description: Determines if there is a live session for a destination and server ID.

methods.name: IsLiveSession
methods.description: Checks if a given session is currently live.

methods.name: SetTickClock
methods.description: Sets the tick clock used by the factory.

methods.name: SetTaskRunner
methods.description: Sets the task runner for the factory.

methods.name: GetPingTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the ping timeout duration for the factory.

methods.name: SetYieldAfterPackets
methods.description: Configures the factory to yield after a specified number of packets.

methods.name: SetYieldAfterDuration
methods.description: Configures the factory to yield after a specified duration.

methods.name: GetNumberOfActiveJobs
methods.description: Returns the number of active jobs for a server ID.

methods.name: CryptoConfigCacheIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the crypto config cache is empty for a server ID and network key.

methods.name: CacheDummyServerConfig
methods.description: Creates and caches a dummy server config for testing.

methods.name: GetNumPushStreamsCreated
methods.description: Returns the number of push streams created.

methods.name: GetNumDegradingSessions
methods.description: Returns the number of degrading sessions.

methods.name: SetAlarmFactory
methods.description: Sets the alarm factory used by the factory.
